data.name: Sulakshana
data.gender_notes: Sulakshana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sulakshana means adornment of the eyes, often referred to as the 'gems of the body'. In Hindu mythology, the eyes are considered to be the windows to the soul and are regarded as sacred. The name signifies beauty and intelligence. The name Sulakshana carries the meaning “Eye adornment, beautiful eyes” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sulakshana usually hope their child will grow to embody eye adornment, beautiful eyes and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sulakshana total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
